name: Server Health Monitor
prompt:
"Build a 'Server Health & Anomaly Monitor'. The data source is a log file with columns: Timestamp, Service Name, Response Time (ms), and Status Code (e.g., 200, 404, 500).

The app needs to feature:

A time-series line chart tracking Response Time over the course of the day.

An 'Incident Feed' component. If any row has a status code starting with '5' OR a response time exceeding 800ms, it must instantly appear in this feed with a blinking red critical status indicator.

A button to 'Clear Resolved Incidents' that filters those specific flagged items out of the current view without deleting the raw data."

thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a real-time monitoring dashboard for an SRE or DevOps persona. The focus is on observability (Response Time trends) and incident response (Log feed with filtering). I've chosen the 'Process Monitor' archetype to prioritize live health metrics and a critical feed.
assumed_from_scratch: Incident Feed component with status indicator animation
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'status_indicator' skill would be useful for defining standardized blinking, pulsing, or color-coded health dots across apps. Additionally, an 'observability_feed' skill would help standardize log/event streaming components.
